title: College Football
description:
Hawaii at Wyoming
Wyoming hosts Hawaii at War Memorial Stadium in Mountain West Week 4 college football play. Wyoming looks to rebound from a road loss, while Hawaii looks to build on a 29-19 win over New Mexico State led by Devon Rice's two rushing touchdowns.

title: College Football
description:
Central Michigan at Miami
The Hurricanes (3-0) host the Chippewas (2-1) at Hard Rock Stadium. Miami beat Wake Forest 33-20 behind Darian Mensah, who threw three TDs and set an ACC record with 24 straight passes. Central Michigan won 24-10 behind Angel Flores' two TDs.

title: College Football
description:
Rice at Fresno State
The Bulldogs host the Owls in a Week 4 regular-season NCAA matchup at the Valley Children's Stadium. QB Jayden Mandal leads Fresno State after throwing for 186 yards last game, while QB Jacurri Brown anchors the Owls with 249 total yards.
